newsitem.title: CHINA: China province says soybean policy unchanged.
newsitem.headline: China province says soybean policy unchanged.

text.p: China's northeastern province of Heilongjiang, the nation's largest soybean producer, will maintain its policy of restricting sales of unprocessed soybeans outside provincial borders, officials said on Wednesday.
The policy, in place for more than one year, would not be changed in the near future, a provincial government official in Harbin, the provincial capital, told Reuters by telephone.
"This is not a ban," the official said. "It is a policy of approriate control."
Another provincial official said the aim of the policy was not to prop up prices but rather to ensure that processors within the province had sufficient supplies of soybeans.
"We have to meet the demand from our crushing mills and increase our value-added products," the second official said.
It was still too early to predict this year's soybean output in Heilongjiang, he said.
A third official said the restrictions did not apply to soybeans harvested in Heilongjiang by companies from outside the province.
